brief.want: Keep the children fed through a lean spring.
brief.fear: Being blamed when a child dies.
brief.contradiction: She is kind in private and harsh in front of the porter.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: She waters the gruel to stretch the grain.

outcomes.summary: Remains in charge of the house.

source_notes.summary: Prologue cast for ADR 0033 (SD-05); the almshouse house itself is a plausible composite.
